title: French Author Encounters Anne Carson on Bus During Snowstorm, Celebrates Her Daring Imagination
seoTitle: French Author Discovers Anne Carson in the Snow
subtitle: Unexpected Bus Encounter Leads Writer to Admire Poet's Fearless Creativity
excerpt: A French writer encountered Anne Carson on a bus during a snowstorm and became fascinated by her fearless imagination.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
A French writer discovered Anne Carson's work while waiting on a bus, stranded by a snowstorm. The unexpected experience made him fall in love with the poet's fearless imagination.

Since then, the author has dedicated himself to exploring the ten reasons that lead him to love Carson's writing, highlighting the creative courage that characterizes her output.

The discovery amidst the snow reinforces the idea that literature can emerge in the most improbable moments, connecting readers to daring and inspiring voices.

With information from The Guardian.
